title: Finitely generated Z-algebras are G-rings
statement: Every finitely generated $\mathbf Z$-algebra, i.e. every commutative ring $R$ generated as a ring by finitely many elements, is a G-ring [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].

source.place: Proposition Tag 07PX (proposition-ubiquity-G-ring, line 12652), items (3) ($\mathbf Z$, a Dedekind domain of characteristic zero whose completions at maximal ideals are discrete valuation rings) and (5) (finite type ring extensions, Proposition Tag 07PV proposition-finite-type-over-G-ring)
